sources_considered.why: Paywall preview. It reports data center debt selling off in secondary markets in October 2026, but a selloff is neither a bubble verdict nor ruin.

unresolved_gaps: The searches found no realized defaults or creditor losses on AI data center debt by 2026-10-28. Even if some had occurred, the claim sets no threshold for 'ruinous'.
